before.title: The Scrapper's Crucible
before.summary: Survive Pitmaster Brutus's 3-wave gladiator machine trials in the Waste Intake.
before.description: Step into the sunken arena north of the Intake Overlook, face three escalating waves of rogue automated war machines under brutal environmental hazards, and claim the legendary Crucible Forge-Plate.
before.flavor: Machines do not bleed, but when the slag hits redline, they certainly crack.

after.speaker: Dock Interlock
after.text: The simulation flashes red: that sequence would shift the pressure loss into an unsealed compartment. No bulkhead moves. Check the map and try again.

before.speaker: Nova
before.text: You are not saving them. You are building a mass grave and calling the silence peace.

after.speaker: Nova
after.text: You are not saving them. You are building a mass grave and calling the silence peace.

after.speaker: Dock Interlock
after.text: Sequence verified. Applying all three seals. Dock pressure is stable. Access priority is a separate control; the workers are still locked out.

after.speaker: Dock Interlock
after.text: The carpet seam is isolated in the simulation. Pressure still falls at the collar. What closes next?

after.speaker: Dock Interlock
after.text: Simulation suspended. No pressure controls changed.

after.speaker: Dock Interlock
after.text: The collar holds. One breach remains against open space.

after.speaker: Dock Interlock
after.text: Pressure map: RED CARPET SEAM → DOCKING COLLAR → OBSERVATION GLASS. The interlock will simulate each command before releasing a bulkhead. Which breach do you isolate first?

before.speaker: Vale
before.text: Thorne wanted to bottle the ocean. I will break the glass. No bodies to starve, no minds to break. Why fight for friction?

after.speaker: Vale
after.text: Thorne wanted to bottle the ocean. I will break the glass. No bodies to starve, no minds to break. Why fight for friction?

before.speaker: Pitmaster Brutus
before.text: Three waves. No ref timeouts, no Dominion safety net. Wave one tests your speed against aerial stingers. Wave two brings out the heavy molten haulers. Wave three is my reigning undefeated Champion. Survive all three, and the Crucible Forge-Plate is yours.

options.text: Let's do this. Open the cage for Round 1!
Give us a moment to prepare.

after.speaker: Pitmaster Brutus
after.text: Three rounds. First: two Magma Drones and a Welder Bot. Second: a Slag Golem with a welder keeping it running. Third: my Champion with a drone escort. Withdraw if you must; only victory clears a round. Rest between bouts, then ask me to start the next. Clear all three and claim the Forge-Plate, 350 credits, and 500 XP.

options.text: Let's do this. Open the cage for Round 1!

before.title: Anchor Chamber
before.description: A tank of conductive fluid hangs inside a cathedral of cables. Elara floats at its center, wired into the Ring as a living processor while the Anchor relic turns beside her. A graviton well bends the light beneath the tank.

description_variants.description: The conductive tank is emptying around Elara's cables. The Anchor relic is gone, and the Hunter-Killer's charge is frozen in a perfect Stasis moment. A graviton well bends the light beneath the tank.
